name: The Garage Music Club
description: The Garage is a lively karaoke bar and open mic venue that offers a welcoming and spacious atmosphere. Known for its friendly staff and great live music, it provides a fun environment for both singing enthusiasts and casual visitors. The venue features a good sound system, a decent song selection, and a relaxed vibe, making it an ideal spot to unwind, enjoy drinks, and showcase your singing talent any night of the week.
